description: Add language-specific Bedrock prompts for sort-ingredients API to improve sorting accuracy for non-English languages (e.g., German)
steps: Update apps/web/src/app/supermarkets/supermarket.service.ts sortIngredients method to accept and pass a language parameter
Update apps/web/src/app/supermarkets/supermarket-view.component.ts sortIntoAisles method to get current language from TranslateService and pass it to sortIngredients
Update apps/api/src/handler.ts sortIngredients function to read language from request body and use German prompt when language is 'de'
Add Language-Specific AI Prompts section to .kiro/steering/conventions.md
acceptance_criteria: sortIngredients service method accepts a language parameter and passes it in the request body
supermarket-view component gets the current language from TranslateService and passes it to sortIngredients
Backend sortIngredients function uses German system prompt and instruction text when language is 'de'
Backend defaults to English prompt when no language specified or language is 'en'
conventions.md has a new section documenting language-specific AI prompts pattern
npx nx run-many -t build lint passes cleanly
